architecture.summary: Tighten the existing T2 architecture comparison guide to use affected C4 Level 3 components in their named Level 2 container, real owners and distinct runtime/source/composition relationships, plus short behavior notes for material authority, payload, order, outcome, replay, and lifetime changes. Retain pinned comparison baselines, complete registry inventory and source review, supplementary-view labels, wider container/deployment impact checks, verified evidence, rendering and source equality, manager feedback, revision rechecks, and one verified comment. This changes manual reporting guidance only and adds no automated gate. Human approval, test, metrics, review-tier, and merge rules are unchanged. The context, container, component, runtime, and deployment views remain accurate because no application source, contracts, runtime configuration, responsibilities, collaborations, external systems, resource ownership, or deployment placement changes. No registry edit is needed.
